edge_cases: Q[0]=127, K[0]=127 (large QKT product within window)
high-magnitude Q[i=0] dot K[j=2] outside window=1 (attending there would be wrong)
V[j=2] is extreme (+127/-128) so outside-window errors are detectable
window=1 vs window=2 sweep (different positions are masked)
masked positions contribute exp_lut[0] not zero (softmax includes them)
name: i8_sparse_attn_block

params.amult: int32 (runtime, swept) -- AV output requant multiplier
params.ashift: int (runtime, swept) -- AV output requant shift
params.exp_lut: 256 uint8 entries for softmax (runtime, swept -- 2 distinct tables)
params.smult: int32 (runtime, swept) -- QKT score requant multiplier
params.sshift: int (runtime, swept) -- QKT score requant shift
params.window: int (runtime, swept: {1, 2}) -- half-width of the attention band
